title: Warning severity bills 30 % of the fixed + per-minute penalty
human: A degraded (warning-severity) incident of 10 minutes under a base 0 + 1 000 000 IRR/min scheme would be 10 000 000 IRR when critical; warnings bill 30 %: 3 000 000 IRR. (The engine passes the 30 % weight per incident; the domain function applies one half-even rounding.)
